finding.summary: The synchronous Partial helper blocks on asynchronous partial-view rendering.
finding.explanation: The reusable synchronous Partial API calls PartialAsync and immediately waits with GetAwaiter().GetResult() on the request/view-rendering path. Partial rendering can perform genuine asynchronous work, so concurrent uses occupy request threads while that work completes. The async PartialAsync overload already provides the nonblocking path; changing or removing the public synchronous API would require compatibility review.
finding.snippet:
var result = htmlHelper.PartialAsync(partialViewName, model, viewData);
return result.GetAwaiter().GetResult();
